newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: NORDIC SKIING-MYLLYLA LEADS FINNS TO SECOND WIN.
newsitem.headline: NORDIC SKIING-MYLLYLA LEADS FINNS TO SECOND WIN.

text.p: Mika Myllyla capped off a perfect weekend by leading Finland to victory in the men's 4x10km relay at the Nordic World Cup on Sunday.
Myllyla, who collected his first individual career World Cup win on Saturday in the 10km freestyle competition, was joined on the podium by Jari Isometsa, Sami Repo and Harri Kirvesniemi.
It was the second consecutive win for the Finnish foursome, who claimed victory in the same event at the season opener two weeks ago in Sweden.
They clocked at one hour 44 minutes 51.2 seconds.
Sweden were second in 1:45:26.2, just four-tenths of a second ahead of Scandinavian rivals Norway, third in 1:45:26.6.
Norway however, claimed first place in the women's 4x5km relay ahead of two Russian teams.

The Norwegian foursome of Bente Martinsen, Anita Moen-Guidon, Marit Mikkelsplass and Trude Dybendahl posted a winning time of 57:41.9, crossing a comfortable 34 seconds in front of the Russian number one team anchored by Elena Vaelbe.
